description:
UF Resources · Bradenton, FL (On-Site) · Full-Time W-2 · Pay based on experience, paid weekly
 Local candidates only: you must live in the Bradenton–Sarasota area now. No relocation, remote, or hybrid.
 Build Claude-powered AI agents for internal tools, customer experiences, and creative workflows, with a small team and senior mentorship.
 What you'll do
 - Build Claude-powered workflows and agents in Python
 - Integrate LLM APIs with REST APIs, databases, and web apps
 - Iterate on prompts and context; build RAG-style workflows
 - Ship clean code with tests, logging, and error handling
 Required
 - 1+ year of applied experience building with LLM APIs
 - Solid Python, REST APIs, and JSON; Git
 - Working knowledge of prompts, tokens, context windows, and hallucinations
 
 Benefits: 
 health, dental, vision, and life after 90 days; paid holidays, PTO, vacation; 401(k) with company match.
 
 To apply: 
 Submit a current resume include a link to something you built with an LLM API
